title: The PS2's Hidden Racing Gem

scenes.fact: The game 'Burnout 3: Takedown' received a 95% on Metacritic.
scenes.text: Did you know there’s an iconic PS2 racing game most never played?
The 'Burnout' series popularized the crash mode in racing games.
Follow if tech moves faster than you can keep up.

description: Discover the PS2 racing gem that many gamers missed! Dive into gaming history and unlock secrets behind iconic titles. Follow for more!
